scripts.launch:check: npm run build:public && npm run check:public && npm run check:deploy
scripts.launch:preflight: npm test && npm run build && npm run launch:check
scripts.launch:ready: npm run check:git-release && git diff --check -- :/ && npm run launch:preflight && npm run launch:strict
scripts.launch:strict: npm run check:env && npm run build:public && node scripts/check-public-build.mjs --strict && npm run check:deploy
